constructor
  · intro h G instG instF p q hcon hsimple
    rcases hcon with ⟨hp, hq, hcard⟩
    have hf : false = true := h (G := G) (p := p) (q := q) hp hq hcard hsimple
    exact Bool.false_ne_true hf
  · intro h G instG instF p q hp hq hcard hsimple
    have hnot : ¬ IsSimpleGroup G := h (G := G) (p := p) (q := q) ⟨hp, hq, hcard⟩
    exact False.elim (hnot hsimple)

constructor
  · intro h G inst _ a b d habd
    exact h a b (a * b) d rfl habd
  · intro h G inst a b c d hab hcd
    exact h (G := G) trivial a b d (by
      rw [hab]
      exact hcd)

constructor
  · intro h F inst p n hf x y hx hy
    exact @h F inst p n hf (p ^ n) rfl x y hx hy
  · intro h F inst p n hf m hm x y hx hy
    rw [hm] at hx hy
    exact @h F inst p n hf x y hx hy

constructor
  · intro h G inst a b hQ
    exact h (G := G) (P := fun i => ∀ (a b : G), (a * b) ^ i = a ^ i * b ^ i)
      (hP := rfl) hQ a b
  · intro h G inst P hP hQ a b
    rw [hP] at hQ
    exact h a b hQ

constructor
  · intro h ι X inst α hAB
    exact @h ι X inst hAB.1 α hAB.2
  · intro h ι X inst hA α ne
    exact @h ι X inst α ⟨hA, ne⟩

  · intro h n r x y z hn
    rcases hn with ⟨hn_ge, hx_y, hr_pos, h2r⟩
    have hd : ‖x - y‖ > 0 := hx_y
    exact h n (‖x - y‖) r x y z hn_ge rfl hd hr_pos h2r
  · intro h n d r x y z hn_ge hd_eq hd_pos hr_pos h2r
    have hd : ‖x - y‖ = d := by rw [hd_eq]
    have h_dist_pos : ‖x - y‖ > 0 := by
      rw [hd]
      exact hd_pos
    have h_ineq : 2 * r > ‖x - y‖ := by
      rw [hd]
      exact h2r
    exact h n r x y z ⟨hn_ge, h_dist_pos, hr_pos, h_ineq⟩
